notes.page_summary: The continuation proposes retaining the homotopy type, expects the six sheaf operations to have an ad-hoc homotopy translation, and considers a moderate map between compact moderate spaces with compatible equisingular stratifications. It asks for a morphism of diagrams of manifolds with boundary and for four operations on constructible sheaves to be expressed through homotopy types. The final sentence explicitly leaves foundational work unfinished and continues beyond this page.

workflow_feedback: The brief successfully separates visual reading from mathematical verification; the empty check_events array records the actual scope here.

C's questions contain comparative English/editorial claims that can bias a reader. For future packets, separate the physical location/question from the old suggested interpretation, while retaining the witness texts for collation.

An exactly-once crop rule is workable when bounding boxes are carefully recorded. Incidental overlap of neighbouring context should be distinguished explicitly from re-cropping the same unresolved feature.

For very small points and strokes, a 3000-pixel-wide enlargement produces a very tall image and adds no detail. A documented fixed-scale exception for tiny nontext marks would reduce display overhead without changing the reading.
